lead_raw_text:
The structure of CaZr₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing six atoms (Ca₂Zr₄) and two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows both Ca and Zr centers adopt 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with Ca coordinated by 12 Zr and Zr by 4 Ca and 8 Zr neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Zr-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, plus corner- and edge-sharing between Ca- and Zr-centered polyhedra.
